annotations.title: Send a suggestion or bug report

description:
Use this when the user wants to tell the RipClip team something: "I have an idea", "report a bug". Write
nothing the user did not say. It goes to the team's inbox like the in-app forms, with the same limits (5 of each
a day, 20 waiting). A built suggestion earns 300 credits and a fixed bug 150; the team decides, nothing is promised.
Not for: help using RipClip or one job's problem (job_status). Free: no Horizon Units.

kind.description: Either "suggestion" (an idea; first line is its title) or "bug".

text.description: The user's own words, up to 4000 characters. For a bug: what they did and saw.
